# ImgUpscaler.ai

> > Free AI-powered image upscaling and enhancement platform supporting resolutions up to 16K with specialized tools for photo restoration, sharpening, and creative transformations.

ImgUpscaler.ai is a comprehensive online image enhancement suite leveraging advanced AI and GAN-based super resolution technology. The platform offers 20+ specialized tools for upscaling, restoration, enhancement, and creative image editing—all accessible without signup or installation.
